subject: VPN connection failing on RTR-0116-01 - unable to access central office systems
description: Store staff are unable to connect to the corporate VPN on the main router (RTR-0116-01). The VPN tunnel was working yesterday but stopped responding this morning. Staff cannot access inventory management and payroll systems. The router shows a solid connection to the ISP, but VPN authentication is timing out. No recent configuration changes have been made.

ticket_history.note: Ticket received and triaged. Confirmed VPN service is down on RTR-0116-01. Restarted VPN daemon and flushed credential cache. VPN tunnel reconnected successfully and staff can now access central systems.

resolution_notes: VPN service was stuck in failed state due to cached authentication credentials. L1 support restarted the VPN daemon process and cleared the credential cache on RTR-0116-01, which restored connectivity to corporate systems. No firmware update or hardware replacement required.
